CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `multistream_settings` (
  `id` int NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `streamer_id` int NOT NULL,
  `mode` enum('affiliate','partner','exclusive') NOT NULL DEFAULT 'affiliate',
  `auto_enable_new_platforms` tinyint(1) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  `created_at` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  `updated_at` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `multistream_settings_streamer_id_unique` (`streamer_id`)
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `multistream_connections` (
  `id` int NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `streamer_id` int NOT NULL,
  `platform` enum('twitch','kick','youtube','facebook') NOT NULL,
  `platform_username` varchar(255),
  `stream_key` text NOT NULL,
  `ingest_url` varchar(500) NOT NULL,
  `enabled` tinyint(1) NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
  `is_twitch_partner` tinyint(1) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  `created_at` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  `updated_at` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`)
);
